messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: KV_CACHE_BLOWUP detected in prod us-west-2. Incident ID: INC-2367. Pager triggered.

maria: I got paged, looking. Seeing a big 5xx spike on the gateway, traces point to kvcache eviction storms and massive cache rebuilds.

sandeep: Confirming metrics: HPA observed CPU 85% -> 20% -> 90% in short windows. Looks like autoscaler thrash tied to sudden batching throughput changes.

eli: Customer-impact note: top-tier tenants A/B/C reporting 500s and timeouts. CS already flagged.

zach: Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/kv-cache-dashboards - notice key_cardinality jump after last deploy (batching-v2). Suggest rollback or emergency config.

maria: Starting canary rollback of batching-v2 on 10% of traffic and applying emergency config: max_batch_size=32, continuous_batching=false.

opsbot: Deploy job queued: deploy-789 by maria. Estimated 2m until canary active.

maria: Also going to increase HPA stabilization window to avoid immediate downscale: patching HPA to 5m stabilization-window.

sandeep: Note: long stabilization helps avoid thrash but can delay recovery for real spikes. We'll monitor and manual-scale if needed. Patching now.

maria: kubectl patch hpa inference-service -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}' # applied

incident-bot: Deploy started: deploy-789 (maria). Canary on 10% traffic.

lisa-cs: @maria @sandeep any ETA for impact reduction? Support seeing escalations.

maria: Canary rollback finished. Error rate on canary nodes down ~60%. Promoting 50% next.

eli: Mitigation checklist: 1) cap batching, 2) increase kv idle TTL to reduce churn, 3) bump HPA cooldown, 4) add prefill jitter, 5) monitor 15m.

zach: Logs reveal many tiny prefixes hammering KV during prefix rebuild. Recommend enabling prefix-dedupe feature flag to collapse similar requests.

sandeep: Prefix-dedupe safe to roll. Toggling in us-west-2 and us-east-1 now.

maria: Toggled prefix-dedupe flag. Seeing immediate drop in kvcache misses.

opsbot: HPA patched: targetCPU=70, stabilization-window=300s.

eli: Customer-impact update: Tenants A/B/C error rates peaked +40%. CS drafting note and offering proactive check-ins.

maria: Applying routing isolation: move heavy tenants to dedicated pool to limit blast radius.

zach: Routing rule applied. Traffic shifting underway.

sandeep: Also observed cache warmup regen pattern — large prefill bursts. I'll add jitter to prefill (0-30s) to smooth spikes.

maria: Prefill jitter config pushed.

opsbot: Config rollout complete.

eli: Metrics: p95 latency trending down, error rate falling. Stable window approaching.

lisa-cs: CS update: customers notified, some responses asking for ETA on full resolution. We're offering credits if SLA violated.

maria: After 20m, autoscaler stopped oscillating and replicas stabilized. No new 5xx surges. Proposing follow-ups: roll out batching-v2 with lowered concurrency, add HPA hysteresis rules, add kv-key-cardinality alert, and run synthetic warmup tests.

sandeep: Agreed. Opening follow-up ticket INC-2367-PM for postmortem, action items, and owner assignments.

zach: I'll schedule a canary with synthetic traffic to validate warmup behavior before next rollout.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2367 marked MITIGATED by maria.

maria: Handoff notes for evening oncall: watch these metrics - kv_cache_miss_rate, hpa_replicas, batch_queue_length, prefix_cardinality. If error rate >5% sustained for 10m, escalate to eng-sre.

oncall-eng: Taking handoff. Will monitor and ping if anything regresses. Nice job team :thumbsup:
